svg.metadata: {"concept_id": "edu.dc-circuit-measurement-topology-model", "profiles": ["swell-paper-v1", "index-embossed-v1", "viewplus-variable-height-v1"], "teaching": "Introduced comparison of DC meter connection topology: current meter in the load path versus potential-difference meter across the load. This is explicitly ONE comparison relationship, not a merged claim that ammeter and voltmeter are the same instrument or two extra named object masters. Source362/363meter identities remain unresolved for exact source fit; independent topology does not certify their tiny labels, polarity or wiring. OpenStax primary body confirms series current/parallel voltage and finite meter loading. Numeric readouts, resistance values, battery chemistry, source internal resistance and physical connection instructions omitted. Idealised connectivity does not mean zero measurement disturbance. No numeral, plus/minus letter glyph or Braille. Shape of blank circle alone does not universally identify meter type.", "geometry_exception": "Native1.2mm graphic dots with3.1mm guard. Continuous4mm sori/junctions and5mm phase badges use one native logical dot each. Junction vertices de-duplicated. Profiles share compatible geometry; no Braille or physical recognition result.", "physical_evaluation": "pending"}

g.data-exception-reason: Native1.2mm graphic dots with3.1mm guard. Logical root/leaf/wire joints shared once; continuous4mm sori/junctions and5mm phase badges use one native dot at each exact centre. This changes mark diameter, not learned one/two count or logical topology. Optional near-junction samples omitted; no Braille or actual tactile validation.
